builds.name: Reference: AP sustained duel
builds.goal: Reference for Gwen: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee AP duelist who stacks attacks into Q, seeks its center line, and uses mist to isolate threats. Sustained contact feeds percent-health damage and healing. Compare Q center hits, passive percent-health damage and attacks between casts. Mist positioning and the number of needle hits must be explicit; phantom hits need mechanic verification. AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration.
builds.summary: AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration.
testPlan: Kit question for Gwen: Compare Q center hits, passive percent-health damage and attacks between casts. Mist positioning and the number of needle hits must be explicit; phantom hits need mechanic verification.

Start with the early core (Riftmaker, then Nashor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Nashor needs actual attacks; little health/resistance makes CC and burst dangerous.

The route fails Gwen's stated kit question: Compare Q center hits, passive percent-health damage and attacks between casts. Mist positioning and the number of needle hits must be explicit; phantom hits need mechanic verification.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Nashor needs actual attacks; little health/resistance makes CC and burst dangerous.
Full cost 17,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Riftmaker, then Nashor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts [6] seconds).

Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for [10 / 14 / 18 / 22 / 26 + (0.05) × AP] magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage. 

The center of each strikes converts [50]% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit.

Deals [80]% damage to minions.
Minions below [20]% health take [1000]% bonus damage instead of reduced damage.

Gwen summons the Hallowed Mist, making her Untargetable to all enemies (except towers) outside the zone for [4] seconds or until she leaves it. While in the Mist, Gwen gains [22 / 24 / 26 / 28 / 30 + (0.07) × AP] Armor and Magic Resist.

Gwen can Recast this Ability once to call the Mist to her. This will automatically Recast the first time Gwen attempts to leave the zone.

Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for [4] seconds.

Empowered Attacks gain [(30 / 42.5 / 55 / 67.5 / 80) × (0.01)] Attack Speed, [15 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit, [75] range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds [(0.25 / 0.35 / 0.45 / 0.55 / 0.65) × 100]% of this Ability's Cooldown.

First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals [30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage, Slows by [(-0.4 / -0.5 / -0.6) × -100]% for [1.5] seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds ([1]s cooldown between casts).

Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (3)] magic damage
Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (5)] magic damage

Gwen's Attacks deal an additional [(1 + (0.006) × AP) × (0.01)] Max Health magic damage on hit. Gwen recovers Health equal to [0.67] of the damage this Ability deals to champions, up to a maximum of [characterLevelInterpolation(12 → 40; raw flags preserved) + (0.07) × AP].
